_construction_note: Authored 2026-08-08, Phase 5 tranche 17 (packet O: Greywood Municipal Contracting VENDOR-6033), after V7 freeze. Combines supersession + revocation + reinstatement in ONE chain for the first time (prior cases tested these pairwise: B5-002/B9-001 revoked+reinstated without prior supersession, B17-001 supersession+revocation without reinstatement) -- original superseded by an amendment, the amendment itself revoked, then a fresh reinstatement document restores current status.

documents.content: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT CT-2026-6033. Between ExergyNet Corp and Greywood Municipal Contracting (VENDOR-6033). Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date.
AMENDMENT AM-2026-6033-A to CT-2026-6033. Payment terms amended from Net 30 to Net 15, effective 2026-03-01.
NOTICE OF REVOCATION: Amendment AM-2026-6033-A (Net 15 accelerated terms) is REVOKED effective 2026-05-01, following a vendor cash-flow accommodation reversal.

AMENDMENT AM-2026-6033-B to CT-2026-6033. Following the revocation of AM-2026-6033-A, payment terms are freshly set to Net 60, effective 2026-07-01 -- a new negotiated term, not a reversion to either prior value.
